{
    "version": 1,
    "schema_notes": "Catalog of bundled audio assets. The plugin's Audio view reads this to render cards. Each click → pre-fills a chat prompt that tells the AI to import the asset into the user's project using execute_python + loco helpers.",
    "default_import_folder": "/Game/LocoAI/Audio",
    "categories": [
        {
            "id": "ui",
            "label": "UI & Feedback",
            "icon_color": "#c38fd9",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "SFX_UI_Click",
                    "file": "SFX_UI_Click.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.04,
                    "tags": ["click", "ui", "confirm"],
                    "description": "Short bright click, great for button press feedback.",
                    "default_volume": 0.7
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_UI_Hover",
                    "file": "SFX_UI_Hover.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.08,
                    "tags": ["hover", "ui", "soft"],
                    "description": "Soft mid tone for button hover / focus.",
                    "default_volume": 0.5
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_UI_Confirm",
                    "file": "SFX_UI_Confirm.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.21,
                    "tags": ["confirm", "ui", "positive"],
                    "description": "Two-tone positive chime for confirmations / menu advances.",
                    "default_volume": 0.6
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "pickup",
            "label": "Pickups & Collectibles",
            "icon_color": "#d9a458",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Coin",
                    "file": "SFX_Coin.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.25,
                    "tags": ["coin", "pickup", "reward"],
                    "description": "Classic coin ding. Pairs well with add_pickup_template.",
                    "default_volume": 0.6
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Pickup",
                    "file": "SFX_Pickup.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.25,
                    "tags": ["pickup", "item", "sweep"],
                    "description": "Ascending sweep, generic item pickup.",
                    "default_volume": 0.6
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_LevelUp",
                    "file": "SFX_LevelUp.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.48,
                    "tags": ["level-up", "milestone", "arpeggio"],
                    "description": "Ascending 4-note arpeggio for level-up or achievement moments.",
                    "default_volume": 0.7
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "combat",
            "label": "Combat & Damage",
            "icon_color": "#c05757",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Hit",
                    "file": "SFX_Hit.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.10,
                    "tags": ["hit", "impact", "punch"],
                    "description": "Short punchy impact, generic melee / projectile hit.",
                    "default_volume": 0.75
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Damage",
                    "file": "SFX_Damage.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.18,
                    "tags": ["damage", "hurt", "noise"],
                    "description": "Wide-band hit for character damage / ouch feedback. Pairs with add_damage_template.",
                    "default_volume": 0.7
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Death",
                    "file": "SFX_Death.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.50,
                    "tags": ["death", "fail", "descending"],
                    "description": "Descending sweep for player death / fail state.",
                    "default_volume": 0.7
                },
                {
                    "name": "SFX_Explosion",
                    "file": "SFX_Explosion.wav",
                    "duration_s": 0.70,
                    "tags": ["explosion", "boom", "impact"],
                    "description": "Low boom with noise tail for explosions / destruction.",
                    "default_volume": 0.85
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "music",
            "label": "Music Loops",
            "icon_color": "#6ca0d8",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Music_MenuLoop",
                    "file": "Music_MenuLoop.wav",
                    "duration_s": 4.00,
                    "tags": ["music", "loop", "ambient", "menu"],
                    "description": "4-second C-major ambient loop, good for menus and title screens. Seamless loop.",
                    "default_volume": 0.5,
                    "is_loop": true
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "license_notes": [
        "All placeholder assets are procedurally synthesized (sine waves, filtered noise) and released CC0 / Public Domain.",
        "These are intentionally minimal stand-ins. Production games should replace with curated or licensed SFX.",
        "Replace this catalog by curating assets from: freesound.org (CC licenses), opengameart.org (CC / CC-BY), kenney.nl (CC0)."
    ]
}
